title: Fable 5.2 is insane
author: FilipeDM
selftext:
With a few assets of your own and the free assets available from Unreal Engine, you can create your own GTA.



[](https://www.reddit.com/submit/?source_id=t3_1xz1uu5&composer_entry=crosspost_prompt)

comments.author: DancinFool82
comments.body: I hate low effort posts like this. Can you give some details? What is the actual gameplay? Do you mean you got Fable to do a bit of boiler plate code work to load a couple assets into one of its existing demos?

replies.author: FilipeDM
replies.body:
Just provide the assets and the prompt, and it does everything.

"Create a GTA-style open world using the incredible collection of free resources I've found."

replies.author: DancinFool82
replies.body: But all you showed is a car model driving around. You can do that by opening one of their car demos and importing a new model
